title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Argument shift method and Jordan-Kronecker invariants of Lie algebras
exact_target: Does every quadratic Poisson structure on a vector space have enough independent commuting polynomial functions for Liouville integrability?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100507 (AMR-020-0507). CC BY 4.0.
